t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, blue, orange and yellow gnomes will give you the most points. Once you pick all of these gnomes and the points from the mushrooms start to decrease, switch to the other four colours as you will carry on getting the most points.

vb_textbox.text: The rewards seem to increase in blocks. The green, blue, orange and yellow gnomes and then the pink purple and brown. If you pick green, blue, orange and yellow one after another you tend to get a bigger reward. One you notice the reward going down, start picking from the pink purple and brown group to continue recieving a better reward.
